evidence.text: the overlay for the race state 4

the original at 0x2e724 holds 50 instructions and 167 bytes: it reads the title pointer at DAT_0011fc38, calls panel_draw_centered at 0x2e7cc with the y 2, the font 3, and the color 2, formats the name at DAT_001203cc with the format \001%s through sprintf at 0x4d32c, draws the buffer at (0x106, 0x98), shifts x by 21 pixels for each unit of DAT_0011d244, and draws the separator \001- at (2 * (0x83 + DAT_0011d244 * 21), 0xb0) through draw at 0x25020

name: race_panel_4
role: draws the race state 4 title, the formatted player name, and the shifted separator
